title: Nuclei extraction protocol for flow cytometry based genome size estimation
author: Abhishek Soni
materials: Liquid Nitrogen spermidine trihydrochloride (Sigma,catalogue number S2501), spermine tetrahydrochloride (Sigma, cat. no. S1141), sucrose (Sigma, cat. no. S9378), Triton X-100 (Chem Supply, cat. No. TL125-P), polyvinylpyrrolidone-360(Sigma, cat. no. PVP360), Trizma Base (Sigma, cat. no. T1503), potassium chloride (Scharlau, cat. no. 0401) 2-mercaptoethanol, 14 M (Sigma, cat. no. M3148), 0.5 M ethylene diamine tetra acetic acid (Biobasic Inc., Product: EB0185)

Sterilised mortar and pestle refrigerated centrifuge equipped with fixed angle rotor (Sigma Model 4-16K), Steriflip vacuum-driven filtration system with 20 µm nylon net filter (Merck Millipore, Cat. no. SCNY00020), 40 µm polypropylene framed cell strainers (Biologix, Product ID 15-1040), Pasteur pipettes (20 µl, 200 µl, 1000 µl, 5000 µl), 50 ml conical bottom centrifuge tubes (Corning, Product ID 430304), 1.5 ml microfuge tubes, 5 ml (12 x 75 mm) polystyrene round bottom tubes (Falcon, Product ID PID0587866)

steps.title: Prepare 10x Homogenisation Buffer (HB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 10x HB containing Trizma Base (0.1 M), Potassium chloride (0.8 M), ethylene diamine tetra acetic acid (0.1 M), spermidine (17 mM), and spermine (17 mM). Adjust pH to 9 using 10 M NaOH.

substeps.instruction: Store in a glass bottle at 4 °C for up to one year.

steps.title: Prepare Triton Sucrose Buffer (TSB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 ml of TSB containing Triton X-100 (20%), 10x HB (10%), and sucrose (0.5 M), making up the final volume to 100 ml with distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Store in a glass bottle at 4 °C for up to one year.

steps.title: Prepare 1x Homogenisation Buffer (HB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 ml of 1x HB containing 10x HB (10%) and Sucrose (0.5 M), making up the final volume to 1 L with distilled water.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB)
steps.instruction: Prepare NIB (50 ml per sample) by mixing 1x HB (48.75 ml), TSB (1.25 ml), and polyvinylpyrrolidone-360 (0.5 gm).

substeps.instruction: Add 125 µl of 2-mercaptoethanol immediately before use.
Keep NIB on ice (stored at 4 °C).

steps.title: Pulverize Leaf Tissue
steps.instruction: Combine 1.8 gm of frozen leaf tissue of the sample species and 0.2 gm of frozen leaf tissue of the internal standard in a sterilized, precooled mortar with liquid N2.

substeps.instruction: Submerge leaf material in liquid N2.
Pulverize material using a mortar and pestle in liquid N2, adding liquid Nitrogen as needed to avoid thawing.
Jab large leaf parts into smaller pieces, then crush into powder using circular round motions of the pestle.
Note: Avoid very fine grinding to preserve nuclear intactness; for larger genomes, keep powder coarsely ground without chunks.

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer leaf powder using a precooled spatula into a precooled 50 ml falcon tube prefilled with 7.5 ml of NIB (kept on ice).

substeps.instruction: Submerge powder in NIB with 4-5 swirls until no clumps are visible.
Add another 7.5 ml of NIB.
Gently mix with occasional end-to-end mixing for 2-3 minutes over a total duration of 20 minutes.
Keep the solution on ice to reduce nuclease activity.

steps.title: Filter and Centrifuge Homogenate
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through a 20 µm vacuum filtration system and transfer the filtrate to an empty 50 ml falcon tube on ice.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C for 20 min at 7000 g if the genome size is below 1000 Mbp.
Centrifuge at 4 °C for 20 min at 3000 g if the genome size is >1000 Mbp.
Carefully discard the supernatant, leaving the green pellet.

steps.title: Perform First Wash
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 ml of NIB to the tube and mix the pellet gently by pipetting out 7-10 times with a 10 ml pipette.

substeps.instruction: Add another 7.5 ml of NIB.
Keep on ice for 10 min with occasional gentle mixing.
Centrifuge as specified in the previous step (7000 g or 3000 g at 4 °C for 20 min).
Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Perform Second Wash
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml of NIB and mix the pellet gently by pipetting out 7-10 times with a 10 ml pipette.

substeps.instruction: Keep on ice for 10 min with occasional gentle mixing.
Centrifuge as specified in the previous step (7000 g or 3000 g at 4 °C for 20 min).
Carefully discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final Wash and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 ml NIB to the tube and mix the pellet with a pipette as done in previous washes.

substeps.instruction: Equally allocate the homogenate into five 1.5 ml microfuge tubes.
Centrifuge microfuge tubes at 7000 g for 10 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant to reveal a white nuclear pellet.
Snap-freeze pellets in liquid N2 without drying the tubes.
Store tubes in a -80 °C freezer.
